gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies that the abstract universally claims PTAS exclusion across the listed criteria even though ordinary Frobenius-norm minimization is polynomial-time solvable and PTAS exclusion is not established for all the other stated criteria. Its proposed qualification directly repairs the same overbroad abstract scope claim.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The abstract overgeneralizes established hardness and PTAS-inapproximability results to every listed criterion, contradicting the polynomial-time Frobenius case and exceeding the results actually established.

component_coverage.gold_component: The abstract's universal no-PTAS claim wrongly covers every listed criterion, including a criterion with an exact polynomial-time algorithm, and must be restricted to criteria for which inapproximability is established.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly names ordinary Frobenius minimization as polynomial-time, identifies unsupported PTAS-exclusion claims for ordinary Schatten-norm and Schatten condition-number minimization, and prescribes distinguishing polynomial-time, NP-hard, and actually established PTAS-exclusion cases.
